description: Main window capability. Deliberately has NO `remote` block: the window only ever shows our own bundled splash page (frontendDist, this app's local origin) or, after main.rs's navigate() call, the arigami-host origin loaded as an ordinary external page — see decision #2 in docs/DESKTOP.md. A `remote.urls` entry here would hand window.__TAURI__ / invoke to that origin, and per Tauri's own advisory, on Windows every iframe that is same-origin with the top-level window ALSO gets that access — which is every extension tab, since they render as same-origin iframes inside the cockpit. Do not add one.
